flags.message: Forward-mode web retrieval used a decisive companion signal: the Solicitor General's parallel stay application in the same litigation (26A124, filed 2026-07-27, pre-cutoff), plus press coverage of the underlying injunction. One surfaced headline post-dated the cutoff (a 2026-08-12 report of another injunction in parallel mail-voting litigation); it did not disclose this application's own disposition, was not opened, and no post-cutoff outcome material was folded into the forecast.
